newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine tax revenue in June up six pct on yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine tax revenue in June up six pct on yr ago.

text.p: Argentina's fiscal revenue in June was up 6.1 percent on the same month last year at 3.9 billion pesos, the Economy Ministry announced Tuesday.
The June revenue figure was 15 percent lower than May this year, when the total was 4.61 billion pesos.

Income tax revenue for June was down 10 percent on a year earlier at $662.7 million, which was 48.6 percent down on May this year -- an especially strong month for income tax revenue since it coincides with income tax payment deadlines.
The breakdown showed that income tax collected by the DGI tax agency was 12 percent lower on June last year at 706 million pesos, and 50.2 percent down on May this year.
Income tax collected by customs however was 36.1 percent up on June last year at 30.6 million, which was just 0.1 percent lower than May this year.
Total value added tax collected was 12.6 percent higher than June last year at 1.49 billion pesos, a 4.1 percent decline on May this year.
Total revenue to the DGI tax collection agency was just 0.2 percent higher than June last year at 2.19 billion pesos -- a 21.1 percent drop on May this year.
Total revenue for customs shot up 26.4 percent June on June to 712.3 million pesos, which was 8.5 percent down on May.
